description:
I possessed a mere maid in a Northern Duke’s household, just a background character in a romance-fantasy novel. A lifetime job with stability, as long as I keep my head down and stay out of trouble? Sounds perfect! 

I planned to save up quietly and one day escape for a peaceful life... But then. 

*“You went to… a Korean cyber university?”* 

*“How… how could Annie know that…?”* 

The heroine — reincarnated from modern Korea — found out I’m a transmigrator too! Now I’m stuck to her like glue, constantly in her spotlight… And worse, her overprotective brother starts to take notice. 

*“You want to quit your job? Who said you could?”* 

The male lead of this childcare story — the one I thought would ignore me — has become obsessed! Help! I’m just an extra! 

Annie’s chaotic survival tale as an ordinary extra in a not-so-ordinary childcare drama begins! 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
